libs.title: Libraries for tools written by AI
libs.howTo: How to bring a library that is missing
libs.steps:
1. On a PC with internet:
   pip download <library> --only-binary=:all: --platform manylinux2014_x86_64 --python-version 3.12 -d agent-studio-wheels
2. Copy all files from agent_studio-wheels into {{folder}}/wheels on the {{brand}} server (data/toolkit/wheels next to docker-compose).
3. Press Install here. {{brand}} installs only from those files; they stay installed when the app is updated.
A plain-Python library can also be copied as a folder (or unzipped) into {{folder}}/site.
